provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Talisman Revised 4th Edition expansion rulebooks: Reaper, Frostmarch, Dungeon, Highland, Sacred Pool, Dragon, Blood Moon, City, Firelands, Harbinger, Cataclysm

steps.text: Unfold the board in the middle
Shuffle the Adventure cards facedown beside the board
Shuffle the Spell cards facedown beside the board
Talisman and Purchase cards faceup beside the board; Toad and Alignment cards handy
Shuffle the characters; deal 1 facedown to each player
Your figure on the start space shown on your character card
Life counters and fate tokens equal to your character's values, plus 1 gold
Characters that start with Spells or Objects draw/take them now
Reaper: Grim Reaper card by the board, his figure on the Portal of Power (optional rule)
steps.note: shuffle this expansion's character, Adventure and Spell cards into their decks

steps.text: Warlock Quest cards shuffled facedown by the board (optional with Reaper)
Frostmarch: shuffle the Warlock Quest cards (with the Reaper's, if used) facedown by the board
steps.note: shuffle this expansion's character, Adventure and Spell cards into their decks

steps.text: Dungeon board next to the main board; shuffle the Dungeon deck beside it
steps.note: Without the board, discard Dungeon-icon Adventure cards when drawn; shuffle this expansion's character, Adventure and Spell cards into their decks

steps.text: Highland board next to the main board; shuffle the Highland deck beside it; Relic cards stay in the box until needed
steps.note: shuffle this expansion's character, Adventure and Spell cards into their decks

steps.text: Sacred Pool: shuffle the Quest Reward cards facedown by the board
steps.note: shuffle this expansion's character, Adventure and Spell cards into their decks

steps.text: Dragon: shuffle its Alternative Ending cards, one random card faceup on the Crown of Command; dragon tokens ready to draw each turn
steps.note: shuffle this expansion's character, Adventure and Spell cards into their decks

steps.text: Blood Moon: Time Card by the board, Day side up; Werewolf card and figure and Lycanthrope cards ready
steps.note: shuffle this expansion's character, Adventure and Spell cards into their decks

steps.text: City board next to the main board; shuffle the Potion and Pet decks; Potion, Magic Emporium, Armoury, Pet and Stables decks by their spaces
steps.note: shuffle this expansion's character, Adventure and Spell cards into their decks

steps.text: Shuffle the Wanted Poster deck, 3 faceup on the City Gate; shuffle the City deck beside the board; Neutral Alignment cards stay boxed
Firelands: Terrain cards and fireland tokens by the board
steps.note: shuffle this expansion's character, Adventure and Spell cards into their decks

steps.text: Harbinger: Harbinger figure on the Harbinger sheet; Omen and Harbinger cards ready
steps.note: shuffle this expansion's character, Adventure and Spell cards into their decks

steps.text: Cataclysm board replaces the main board
steps.note: shuffle this expansion's character, Adventure and Spell cards into their decks

steps.text: Shuffle the Remnant deck; 1 facedown Remnant card per Remnant symbol on each space; box the rest
Shuffle the Denizen, Talisman and Warlock Quest decks facedown by the board
"The Eternal Crown" Alternative Ending on the Crown of Command
Alternative Ending: revealed variant - remove hidden-icon cards, shuffle, one faceup on the Crown of Command; hidden variant - remove revealed-icon cards, one facedown
The game's owner goes first; play proceeds clockwise

modules.name: Alternative Ending card
modules.note: Optional; from Frostmarch, Highland, Sacred Pool, Dragon, Blood Moon, City, Firelands, Harbinger or Cataclysm.
